Alice — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary up front: Redwood does not knowingly request or target under-13 data; we provide guidance and tooling for age gating, we offer contractual commitments in the DPA and a separate minors-data attestation. I’m looping in Legal (Priyom) and Security (Monica) to attach the formal artifacts.

Attached in this reply: Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf (latest DPA with SCCs referenced), minors-data-commitment.pdf (attestation describing prohibited uses and retention limits), and an architecture sketch for age-gating integration (age-gating-architecture.png).

Key points:
- Platform behavior: Redwood’s hosted inference API does not perform profiling-based ad targeting out of the box. We prohibit use of outputs for targeted advertising to minors in our terms and the attestation.
- Data processing: customer inputs are treated as customer content. We do not ingest child PII for training or model improvement unless specifically opted in under a separate agreement (and that flow is not part of standard hosting).
- Retention: request-level logs tied to debugging are retained for a configurable short window; customer can opt for shorter retention or disable logs entirely under Dedicated/Private deployments. See minors-data-commitment.pdf for concrete retention windows and deletion processes.
- Age gating: we provide SDK guidance (client-side + server-side checks) and a recommended pattern for not forwarding requests flagged as underage to the inference endpoint. The attached PNG shows the suggested flow.

If you want a one-page attestation on company letterhead for procurement, Priyom — can you generate a short signed statement we can send to BrightStart? Monica — please confirm the security controls referenced in the attestation (SOC2 control references and logging/retention options).

Next steps: Priyom to supply signed attestation + confirmation of SCCs; Monica to confirm security control refs. Once Alice confirms the artifacts look good we can DocuSign the DPA.

Thanks,
